controlledArchitectureEvolution.gap: Per-source top document identity could select InvoiceNo for Accounting even when OrderID was the unique canonical identity shared with Sales.
controlledArchitectureEvolution.resolution: The review surface now projects the unique shared identity from existing canonical candidates for the active governed bundle. It remains a suggestion and becomes evidence only after explicit user acceptance.

controlledArchitectureEvolution.gap: A blocked relationship could leave the review surface and expose a source-local action that the multi-source wrapper had blocked.
controlledArchitectureEvolution.resolution: Blocked multi-source builds remain in review with exact blockers; only ready analyses transition to an active governed dataset.

controlledArchitectureEvolution.gap: React Strict Mode could cancel the first auto-preview timer after the session was already marked as executed.
controlledArchitectureEvolution.resolution: The session is marked only when the surviving timer starts, preserving one execution per session.

controlledArchitectureEvolution.gap: A defensive blocked result was rendered by the legacy result card and could crash on missing chart/template fields.
controlledArchitectureEvolution.resolution: Blocked results now render a source-review alert without touching legacy chart fields.

governanceRetained: No generic six-source join is authorized.
Every selected source is independently profiled and fully materialized.
Shared identity, role, period and currency remain explicit source-bound declarations.
Invalid identity, role, period, currency, cardinality and stale-source probes fail closed.
Decision use remains prohibited until separately reviewed and authorized.
